# run
# expect X-Test: yes
# note the Host line rides along, but an absolute request URI carries the
# note authority, so it is the URI the request is sent to
>>> f.rr
-- sends the request headers --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
X-Test: yes

>>> want f.rr
-- sends the request headers --
GET {{url}}/ HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
X-Test: yes

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 5
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
>>> stdout
-- sends the request headers --
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 5
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
